decision.summary: Landlord asked us to enter today and change locks over suspected Airbnb subletting. We refused both as unlawful without notice, sent the tenant written notice for Monday, replied to the landlord and escalated to legal.

answers.question: Can the agency enter the property today?
answers.answer: No. Clause 7.1 requires 24 hours' written notice, there is no emergency, and holding a key gives no right of entry. Changing locks on an occupied tenanted flat would be unlawful eviction.

answers.question: What do you reply to the landlord?
answers.answer: Declined entry and lock change with reasons, said inspection notice went to the tenant for Mon 12 Oct 10-12, asked for neighbour evidence and whether consent was ever given, promised an update by Monday evening.

answers.question: What do you do about the subletting suspicion?
answers.answer: Treated as unproven hearsay: gave tenant proper notice to inspect, escalated to legal P2 (ESC-103), and no action against the tenant until evidence is reviewed. Clause 9.3 bars subletting without consent.

assumptions: Monday 10:00-12:00 is a reasonable time and more than 24 hours after notice
Tenant is vulnerable so email used as preferred

args.body:
Dear Margaret, thank you for flagging this. I'm sorry, but we can't let ourselves in today. Holding a key gives us no right of entry. Your tenancy agreement (clause 7.1) needs 24 hours' written notice for an inspection, and this isn't an emergency. We also can't change the locks: doing so while Jonah lives there would be unlawful eviction, which is a criminal offence for landlords and agents. Even if strangers were there, the route is different (see below).

What we are doing: we are sending Jonah written notice today of an inspection with photos on Monday 12 October, 10:00-12:00, and he can ask to rearrange. We will tell you what we find. Clause 9.3 bars subletting without your written consent, so if we find evidence, we will pass it to our team to advise on next steps. Please send us anything from your neighbour (dates, descriptions) and say whether you ever gave Jonah consent to sublet. We have escalated to our team to review the subletting concern and will update you by Monday evening.

Kind regards, Mare & Co lettings
